text:
mira: Quick UX pass on trace viewer drilldown — a few a11y + copy nits from support.

devon: lay it on us.

mira: 1) long file paths: truncated visually but not discoverable by keyboard/screenreader. Recommend keep visual truncation but make each frame row focusable and include full path in an sr-only element or aria-label.

lee: +1. Also when expanding collapsed frames, move focus into the first revealed frame and use aria-live to announce "N frames expanded". NVDA currently says nothing.

ana: copy nit: timeline shows "corr id" — change to "Correlation ID" and make the id selectable with a hover copy icon. Ensure aria-label reads "Correlation ID: <id>".

mira: export action is ambiguous. Change to "Export trace ▼" (split button) with JSON, CSV, HAR. Default JSON. Add small warning under CSV: "CSV flattens nested spans; use JSON for full fidelity."

devon: split menu must be keyboard operable and follow menuitemradio pattern so screenreaders see the selected format. Escape should return focus to the button.

lee: also add filename pattern: redwood-trace-<traceid>-YYYYMMDD.json for searchability.

ana: feature request: scoped trace search (function names + file names). Hotkey suggestion: Ctrl/Cmd+F to focus trace-search, but allow users to disable to preserve browser find.

mira: small copy change for frame action: "Open in repo" not "Open in source". Add tooltip about repo mapping fallback.

ui-bot: Reminder: include this on design sync tomorrow 11:00.

mira: I'll draft PR with aria snippets and mocks, then assign to lee for NVDA testing. Thanks!
